title: Scenario 3 — Multi-source Conflict, Two People Same Name, Indirect Closure

events.content: Quick brain dump before this meeting. Sam from the studio said he’d send the revised contract today. Sam — my cousin Sam, not studio Sam — is supposed to pick Mum up Thursday but he’s useless so remind me to check Wednesday evening. The dentist texted but I didn’t read it. I think my appointment moved. And Lucy owes me £240 for the camera, unless she already sent it because there’s some random £240 in my account from yesterday and I don’t recognise the surname.
Incoming £240 from L. HARGREAVES. No memo.
Attached. I changed clause 7 as discussed. Please confirm by Wednesday 17:00 if you’re happy.
Your appointment on Thursday 10:00 has been rescheduled to Friday 09:20. Reply YES to confirm.

I saw the contract. Clause 7 is better but I’m not agreeing tonight, I want to read it properly tomorrow. The dentist thing is Friday now, I replied yes. The £240 might be Lucy because her surname starts with H, actually. Don’t count it as paid until I ask her though.
Studio Sam contract is fine. I replied ‘looks good to me, go ahead’. I didn’t sign anything though. Is that enough? Also Lucy hasn’t answered me.
Thanks — I’ll treat that as approval and send the final signature copy tomorrow.
Yep that £240 was me! Sorry, should’ve put camera in the reference x

I have a feeling I was meant to check something about Mum tonight. Oh — cousin Sam. I texted him and he said yes he’s still picking her up at 3 tomorrow. So that’s fine. Also Lucy finally replied, all sorted.
Event “Mum pickup — Sam” marked completed by user.
Today was a mess but Mum got home fine. Dentist tomorrow morning. Did the contract ever come back? I don’t remember seeing it.
Apologies for the delay. Final copy attached for signature.

I’m literally leaving for the dentist, remind me about the contract this afternoon because I will forget. And if I come back moaning about Sam later I mean studio Sam, cousin Sam actually did what he said for once.
Oh, I signed the contract about an hour ago. Nearly forgot. Anything else hanging?
